sentence: This project gets a super-resolution laser scanning confocal microscope to support life sciences research in cell biology and developmental biology.
This project studies how plant proteins with lipid sensors connect metabolism and day-night signals to gene expression and growth.
This project studies how Anolis lizards decide whether the gonads develop into testes or ovaries.
This project studies which genes explain differences in size, growth and reproduction across many eucalyptus species.
This project studies how to protect microelectronic hardware devices from cyber and physical attacks.
This project builds a tool that uses DNA barcodes to detect many mRNA molecules in cells with fluorescence and electron microscopes.
This project builds computer tools that help researchers find where DNA methylation changes happen and which genes they affect.
This project studies how repair proteins first recognize damaged DNA.
This project uses computer methods to study biology topics such as cell biology, ecology and protein structure.
This project studies how bacteria control lipoprotein modification when the cell envelope is under stress.
This project builds optical sensing methods that speed up the analysis of tricky organic molecules and mixtures without physical separation.
This project studies how breast cancer changes lymphatic vessels and causes lymphedema, and looks for ways to treat it.
This project builds a fiber-optic source of entangled photons that works at room temperature.
This project builds faster ways to train and run large language models that use fewer computer resources.
This project studies how confidence, expectations and goals affect whether people stay in and finish science degrees.
This project studies how the brain of a fruit fly larva turns sensory cues into movement and group behavior.
This project studies how a virus infects turtlegrass, a seagrass, and how the infection affects the plant's health.
This project studies how better genetic testing could change who buys insurance and how insurance markets work.
This project studies how many small quantum devices can work together as one reliable quantum computer.
